selection.rule: First retained source row in the first selected view of each publication, fixed before pilot predictions; no measured signs or prediction-dependent selection.

numerics.value_reference: Independent generic fixed-row scalar assembly for UU, signed FUT and source amplitude; shared native rows and initial functions are explicitly not independent evolution.

resources.measurement: GNU time around each complete Julia producer/auditor command: direct-child maximum RSS, wall/user/system seconds and exit. Retain tool hash/version and raw resource text. This is not simultaneous process-tree peak memory.

reporting.products: Three individual resource/value/AD sample reports, separate arithmetic audits and a complete three-case measurement ledger; no experimental comparison plot, chi2, pulls, refit or uncertainty interval.

limitations: Three deterministically chosen source rows do not certify all132 observations, a fit domain, accepted derivatives, native convergence, tails or performance.
